prompt: Draft a production script for EP01 — The Silicon Trap using the research brief, angle memo, and format spec only (no skill).

assertions.text: Script uses two-column table format with NARRATION and VISUAL PRODUCTION headers
Script has 5 beats with titles and time ranges
Every visual entry has a mode tag ([FOOTAGE:], [MG:], or [LAYERED:])
Every visual entry has a priority tier (P1, P2, or P3)
Factual claims are tagged with {✅}, {⚠️}, or {NEW}
Asset summary includes mode breakdown table, Remotion compositions, stock footage, images/archival tables
Beats are organized by escalating tension, not by logic/topic order
Final beat closes on concrete personal stakes (your car, your phone, your life), not epistemological observation
No 'let me explain' or 'to understand this first' explainer moves; uses decoder framing throughout
Viewer feels personally implicated or encounters a contradiction/stakes within first ~30 seconds
Named concept ('The Silicon Trap') appears 3+ times with accumulating meaning
Checkpoint beats appear every 3-5 minutes (consolidation moments)
Both US and China perspectives shown with internal logic on their own terms (including Chinese emotional framing like 卡脖子)
Script includes [VISUAL-FIRST] or [COUNTERPOINT] annotations at turning points
A visual motif is planned that appears early and evolves across beats
Mode balance within targets: FOOTAGE 50-70%, MG 20-30%, LAYERED 5-15%
No [FOOTAGE:] specs for abstract concepts that cameras can't capture
